answer_1.quote: SLMs typically involve three components to enable end-to-end speech interactions: tokenizer, language model (LM), and vocoder. Given an input speech, the tokenizer first encodes the audio waveform into speech tokens or representations, LM then autoregressively generate token response, and vocoder synthesizes the output token back into speech waveform.

answer_2.quote: To assess the spoken responses provided by the SLMs, we utilize the OpenAI ASR model whisper-large-v3 to convert their answers into text. Afterward, we apply string matching to determine the final answer (e.g., A, B, C, or D) from the transcription and calculate the accuracy.
